reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Matilda Pokrivchak
reviews.text: Welsh Lawncare is the best Lawncare service around!! They are trustworthy, efficient and do an excellent service on your property. Steve Welsh is the owner and he gets back to you quickly with any questions you may have. He has an excellent team working for him. They are all hardworking!! I have had them for a long time and recommend them with more than a 5+ Review!!

reviews.author: Barry Coopersmith
reviews.text: Steve and his men did a wonderful, late season leaf pick up for me. They worked long hours under tough conditions to finish the job before winter weather hit. Pricing was fair and reasonable.
